name: Kwork

account.credential_note: email/username/userId are identifiers; the password lives in multiplatform/secrets/kwork.env (gitignored)

model_notes: Kwork is Fiverr-shaped: sellers POST kworks (service listings); buyers buy them. There is NO public buyer-gig board to apply to. Autonomous action = post kwork service listings (title/description/price/category/packages).

auth.detail: The `slrememberme` cookie works over plain HTTPS: a fresh slrememberme value bootstraps a logged-in session (returns RORSSQIHEK session cookie + csrf_user_token). Login form: https://kwork.com/settings (email 'Email address or username', 'Password', 'Sign In'). Verified: profile /user/<slug> returns 200 + 'Freelancer'.

blocker.what: Create-Kwork link renders on /seller but is SOFT-GATED: clicking it (even logged in) does not navigate to a form (no document request, no modal). Account has window.isEmailVerified=true, window.actorPhoneVerified=null, isSellerOnboardingTester=true, but NO window.isUserWorker. The /seller page shows a 'New phone number' input (phone-linking is part of onboarding).
blocker.constraint_1_phone: Phone verification is required to complete onboarding / unlock create-kwork. BUT the harness rental-SMS provider (sms_services) supports only 30 consumer services (linkedin, google, uber, telegram, vkcom, ...) and NO freelance platforms (no kwork/flru/weblancer). So a rental number cannot be used for Kwork. A real number the user controls (or a provider-supported number) is needed.
blocker.constraint_2_session: agent-browser sessions do NOT persist across separate shell invocations (idle-out in ~1-2 min). Multi-step RE (login -> form -> submit -> capture) MUST be done in ONE command/session.
blocker.fix: 1) Link a phone number on /seller (need a real number — SMS provider does not cover kwork). 2) Complete the seller profile onboarding to set window.isUserWorker=true. 3) Confirm 'Create a Kwork' navigates to the form. 4) In ONE session: open the form, `agent-browser network har start`, fill a draft kwork, submit, `agent-browser network har stop`, inspect the POST (likely /save-kwork or /api/... endpoint) for fields+payload. 5) build kwork-orchestrator.mjs (brain: generate kwork ideas) + kwork-apply.mjs (driver: POST the kwork) + kwork-orch.sh (worker). 6) enable in registry.
blocker.next_session: Blocked on a usable phone number for Kwork. Once available, run the single-session create-kwork RE above.
